findings.passage: There's a lot of people on the rolls throughout Kansas that have passed away, and sometimes it is hard to get them removed because they don't have the evidence that they need.
findings.note: Quoted by the Linn County Journal (Charlene Sims) from his mid-session report to the county commission. Same article reports him describing a bill under consideration that would have the motor vehicle agency send a list of non-citizens to the Secretary of State to be checked against voter lists, and another letting election officers use funeral-home information to remove deceased voters. Those descriptions are the reporter's paraphrase, not his quoted words.
